spec: Part VIII 8.1 · A27 (a) as ruled 2026-09-18 (owner-approved) — a day is judged by the training days in effect on that day; a change takes effect from the dayKey it is saved, forward, never backward

vectors.title: a change mid-week leaves the earlier days judged by the old days
vectors.rule: Mon/Wed/Fri until a change saved on Thursday to Tue/Thu/Sat: Monday and Wednesday count; Tuesday, before the change, was a rest day under the days then in effect, so it is never a miss; Thursday counts under the new days — the streak is 3. Judged by the new days alone, Tuesday would have broken it.

vectors.title: a day after the change is judged by the new days
vectors.rule: Mon/Wed/Fri until a change saved on Monday to Tue/Thu/Sat: from that Monday on only the new days are required — Monday and Wednesday, planned under the old days, ask nothing; Tuesday and Thursday count, 2 → 4; Saturday is planned under the new days, holds no workout and breaks the streak to 0. Longest stays 4.

variants.label: Wed, Fri under the old days; Tue, Thu under the new

vectors.title: a perfect week that spans a change
vectors.spec: 8.1 V87; 5.6.1 recompute; G6 as amended by A22 G1 (a) and A27 (a)
vectors.rule: Mon/Wed/Fri until a change saved on Wednesday to Tue/Thu/Sat: the days planned AT THE TIME are Monday (old days) and Thursday and Saturday (new days — Wednesday, the day of the change, is judged by them and is rest). All three carry a completed workout, so Saturday completes a perfect week: +150 and a shield.

vectors.title: a past miss and a consumed shield both survive a change
vectors.spec: 8.1 V88; 5.6.1 recompute; Flow 7 (shields); A27 (a) as ruled 2026-09-18
vectors.rule: A perfect Mon/Wed/Fri week earns a shield (streak 3). The next Monday is missed and the shield absorbs it; Wednesday is missed with no shield and the streak breaks to 0. On Thursday the days change to Tue/Thu/Sat — under which Monday and Wednesday are rest days — and neither the consumed shield nor the miss comes back: Thursday counts 0 → 1, shields 0, longest 3.

variants.label: a perfect week, two misses, then the change

vectors.title: a completed session on a day that is no longer planned still counts and still advances the rotation
vectors.spec: 8.1 V89; 5.6.1 recompute; A1 (the pointer is derived from completed sessions); A27 (a) as ruled 2026-09-18
vectors.rule: Monday's push workout is completed on a Mon/Wed/Fri plan (stamped isPlannedDay) and the days change that same Monday to Tue/Thu/Sat, so Monday is no longer planned. The session is a fact and is never re-judged: it still pays the planned +100, still counts the day (streak 1 → 2), and still moves the rotation — after legs then push, the next workout is pull.

variants.label: legs on Friday, push on the Monday of the change

vectors.title: an earned perfect week stands when a change later in the week plans a remaining day
vectors.spec: 8.1 V90; 5.6.1 recompute; G6 as amended by A27 (a) (an earned reward stands)
vectors.rule: Mon/Wed/Fri all done: Friday completes a perfect week under the days then in effect (+150, a shield). On Saturday the days change to Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat — Saturday is now planned, holds no workout, and the shield just earned absorbs the miss (streak 3 holds). The perfect week earned on Friday stands: a change never reaches back into what was already awarded.

variants.label: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, then Saturday is added
